svg.title: Giuseppe Bellamacina (@GiuseppeBellamacina) — GitHub profile

g.text: Hi there! I'm Giuseppe an AI Engineer focused on building
LLM-based systems for retrieval, structured reasoning, and
I currently work on AI systems used in operational
environments, including projects connected to public
healthcare organizations and the Italian Air Force Academy.

svg.title: Perfect Month: every day of a calendar month
Marathon Day: 100 contributions in one day
Phoenix: came back after 90+ quiet days
Friday Deployer: Friday is your busiest day
Hacktoberfest Hero: 10 active days in one October
Trick or Commit: contributed on October 31
Unlucky Coder: contributed on a Friday the 13th
Programmer's Day: contributed on the 256th day of a year
May the Fourth: contributed on May 4
Profile Crafter: a repository named like you
Old Guard: code in COBOL, Fortran, Assembly, Perl...
